meaning: the entity is one knob of a site template: an integer the agent and the user set before a site is made, with its label, its unit, its range or options, and its default
_notes: `owner` is `agent-studio`, who answers for this shape today; the registry moves ownership freely (world-proto server/DESIGN.md section 7). Lead decided, say if not.

The schema is open to fields it does not name, as every registry schema is (world-proto SPEC section 9's lenient reading), so a misspelt optional field passes WPS and is carried unread. Lead decided, say if not.

`description`, `group`, `order` and `checks` are the template spec's additions to the knob fields Daniel ruled (briefs/w3-00-rulings.md, D74: label, unit, min, max, step, options, default); `group` is a string and `order` an integer, as the spec's example writes them. Lead decided, say if not.
`deg` values are quarter turns, read as multiples of 90 degrees. Lead decided, say if not.
`checks[].value_unit` is optional and reads as `count` when absent. Lead decided, say if not.

Not in the schema, the template evaluation engine's to check: `key` unique in the template; `min` at most `max`; `default` a valid value; every name in an expression a declared knob, and the grammar beyond its alphabet and length.

schema.title: template.knob
schema.description: the entity is one knob of a site template: an integer the agent and the user set before a site is made, with its label, its unit, its range or options, and its default
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 05-template-workflow.md section 3.2 and 3.3 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/05-template-workflow.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

key.description: The name expressions use for this knob, unique in the template; never `min` or `max`, which name the two calls.

label.description: What a person reads beside the control.

unit.description: `count`; `mm`, a length in whole millimetres; or `deg`, an angle whose values are quarter turns. A choice among codes is an options knob of unit `count`.

min.description: The lowest value of a range knob.

max.description: The highest value of a range knob.

step.description: A range knob's valid values are min + i * step, up to max.

options.description: An options knob's valid values, each with the label that says what it means.

default.description: The value a new draft starts at: an integer, one of the knob's valid values; or an expression over the other knobs (spec 05 section 3.3's grammar: knob keys, + - * / with floor division, min, max, parentheses, integers), evaluated in dependency order at every evaluation while the person has not set this knob, snapped to the knob's step and clamped to its range (D120: an outline follows the aisles and stations it must fit).

oneOf.$comment: spec 05 section 3.3, the knob grammar; section 3.2, the derived default (D120)

description.description: What the knob changes, in a sentence.

group.description: The heading the knob form shows the knob under.

order.description: The knob's place within its group.

checks.description: Problems the user fixes by changing this knob.

check.title: check
check.description: A problem that holds while `fails_when` is one or more.

severity.description: An error blocks Create site and update; a warning does not.

value_unit.description: The dimension of `fails_when`'s value; at `mm`, `{value}` prints in millimetres.

problem.description: What the user reads: `{value}` prints the expression's value, and a knob's key in braces prints that knob's value with its unit.

expression.title: knob expression
expression.description: An integer expression over the template's knobs: integers, knob keys, + - * / (floor division), min and max, parentheses, separated by spaces (05-template-workflow.md section 3.3). The schema holds its alphabet and its 512-character limit; the template evaluation engine parses it and refuses a name that is not a declared knob.
